name: register_context
title: Register context
description: Attach an external context source to a meeting: an external transcript with speaker names (Notion AI minutes, Zoom / Meet / Teams transcript), a chat log, a document, a URL or free text. Exactly one of `content` (inline text), `url` (http/https) or `file_path` (absolute local path of a regular, non-hidden file of at most 16 MiB; `~` is not expanded) must be given. The raw payload is stored verbatim in the bundle (context/sources/<context_id>.json) as the source of truth. For a transcript source_type (notion_ai_minutes, zoom_transcript, meet_transcript, teams_transcript) with a text payload, the deterministic parsers (WebVTT with `Speaker: text` prefixes and `<v Name>` voice tags, SRT, Zoom `HH:MM:SS speaker: text` txt, plain text with optional `[hh:mm:ss]` prefixes) then run immediately: on success the transcript is written as bundle artifact `transcripts/ext-<context_id>` (usable by get_transcript and alignment; speaker names feed layer-4 diarization) and `status` reports `parsed`. An unrecognised payload is not an error — `status` stays `stored`. `url` payloads are stored as references and never fetched at registration, so they always report `stored`. With auto_regenerate=true a `regenerate` job is enqueued so the new context takes part in alignment and minutes generation; its job_id is returned. `scope` is the scope selector (default deny: a scoped meeting needs its scope in the request). When auto_regenerate=true and the saved minutes_model is non-null, expected_config is required and must be the full effective config confirmed by the caller; without generation it is optional. Any supplied expected_config is compared with the current config under the meeting lock before changes or job creation; a mismatch returns configuration_conflict without sending or generating. `request_id` is the client-generated idempotency key: repeating the call returns the same context_id. On failure returns an error_envelope (isError=true) with code: not_found (unknown meeting, or file_path does not exist), scope_denied (the request does not cover the meeting's scope), invalid_argument (none or more than one of content / url / file_path, a file_path that is relative, hidden, not a regular file or too large, or a payload that does not fit source_type), busy (a job is queued / running for the meeting — nothing is stored in that case — or auto_regenerate while the meeting is still recording), policy_violation (auto_regenerate with a provider not allowed by external_send_policy), configuration_conflict, authentication_required, engine_unavailable, model_unavailable, internal.

source_type.description: Kind of source. Transcript kinds (notion_ai_minutes, zoom_transcript, meet_transcript, teams_transcript) are parsed into transcript source ext-<context_id> at registration when the payload is recognisable text; chat_log / document / text / url / file are stored as context for minutes generation and never parsed.

content.description: Inline text payload (the transcript / document body). Mutually exclusive with url and file_path.

url.description: http(s) URL of the source. Stored as a reference only — never fetched at registration (a fetch would leave the machine; a later, policy-checked step may follow it). Mutually exclusive with content and file_path.

file_path.description: Absolute path of a local file whose content is copied into the bundle. Mutually exclusive with content and url.

label.description: Optional human-readable label shown in get_meeting.contexts.

expected_config.description: Full effective config confirmed by the caller, as returned by get_meeting. Required by the server when auto_regenerate=true and the saved minutes_model is non-null. Optional without generation. If supplied, it must match the current config under the meeting lock before storing or enqueueing; mismatch returns configuration_conflict.

auto_regenerate.description: Enqueue a regenerate job after storing (default false).

status.description: stored = raw payload saved only; parsed = also parsed into transcript source ext-<context_id>.

job_id.description: Present when auto_regenerate=true: the enqueued regenerate job.
